About

I am a first-year PhD student at Tsinghua University and a research intern at Tencent Hunyuan. I work on embodied agents driven by frontier models.

I don't keep count of my papers because they are an old currency. On this page they show up as evidence for a judgment I made at the time. What I care about is calling something early and putting real work behind the call, and when my call turns out wrong it stays here, struck through. I change topics when the technology moves, and I won't retell that as one long line of research, which is the polite fiction of our field. I believe that with the right people and the right taste, technology moves faster than any career plan can follow.

To go deep on any of this, whether to collaborate or just chat, email me anytime.

“One finds limits by pushing them.”

Herbert A. Simon, whom I look up to most

Selected research topicseach with the bet I made going in

Embodied agents driven by frontier models

Bet, Oct 2026Embodied AI should be System 2-centric, with System 1 built around what System 2 needs, rather than the opposite.

JustRUA: A Controlled Study of GPT-6 Robot-Use Agents

arXiv, Nov 2026Project pageCode

One persistent GPT-6 conversation controls a dual-arm robot in RoboDojo. Controlled ablations show which parts of the harness actually move the score. I led the project.

Reinforcement learning for reasoning

Bet, Dec 2024RL is the key to reasoning. A clever method is a pleasure to build, but the results rest on verifiable rewards and a simple, reliable training stack.

Process Reinforcement through Implicit Rewards

PRIME, arXiv, Feb 2025Code

Online RL for LLM reasoning with dense token-level rewards, taken from an implicit process reward model that needs outcome labels only. As a core contributor I built the training stack on verl and upstreamed the first parallel verification-reward code in the verl repo.

AutoTriton: Automatic Triton Programming with Reinforcement Learning in LLMs

arXiv, Jul 2025Code

An 8B model trained with SFT and then RL to write Triton GPU kernels. I built the sandbox that verifies the generated kernels.

MiniCPM-V 4.5: Cooking Efficient MLLMs via Architecture, Data, and Training Recipe

CVPR 2026Code

An 8B multimodal model with a unified 3D resampler for images and video, and a hybrid RL stage for short and long reasoning. I did the reasoning cold start and nearly all of the final RL experiments.

Data attribution for data curation

Bet, Aug 2024Data curation should run on optimization theory. In practice it runs on intuition and taste earned from empirical lessons, and for large-scale pretraining the best filter may be no filter at all.

DRIFT: Data Selection for LLM Instruction Tuning via On-Policy Attribution

arXiv, Jun 2026Project pageCode

Scores every training sample by its influence on the model's own rollouts, then continues training on the top 10%. I am the first author.

Early LLM agents

Bet, Jun 2023At that time agents were capped by the base model, so I expected them to take on the tedious work first, well before social simulation or full autonomy.

RCAgent: Cloud Root Cause Analysis by Autonomous Agents with Tool-Augmented Large Language Models

arXiv, Oct 2023CIKM 2024

A tool-using LLM agent for root-cause analysis of cloud jobs, built on an internally deployed model and integrated into Alibaba Cloud's Flink platform. I am the first author.
